dct_title_s: Global Digital Elevation Map (Greyscale Shaded Relief), Terra / ASTER
dct_description_sm: The ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model (GDEM) Greyscale Shaded Relief layer shows surface elevation as shaded relief in shades of grey. Features such as mountains, valleys, plateaus and canyons with steep slopes will appear more rough, while flat areas will appear more smooth.
A visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS). Made from ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003 (ASTGTM, version 003, doi:10.5067/ASTER/ASTGTM.003).
